items.title: 68239_Ram Ramirez oral history interview
items.q: His name was Norman Granz. And he got us to play concerts down at the high school in San Diego.

ctx.x: Now, how was that? You hadn't accompanied Blues singers much before.

Well, I played with T-Bone back in the days when...at the Plantation, when John Kirby was there. And also there was a fellow there working in a real estate office. His name was Norman Granz. And he got us to play concerts down at the high school in San Diego. And T-Bone and I used to ride down there, with Oscar Pettiford, Sir Charles Thompson, Red Nichols and his Pennies and Nat Cole...
You mean this is before Jazz at the Philharmonic.
